summary: Keep remote MCP ingress bounded, snapshot destinations owned by the server, and SQL guidance tied to the actual local framework store.
reason: Authentication starts after HTTP headers are read, so the listener needs read deadlines. MCP callers act as the server account and must not select filesystem destinations; direct CLI operators may select their own cache directory. Japan Guide facts are JSON snapshots and this CLI has no sync command.
call_sites: Guide facts are extracted JSON snapshots outside this database
validated_outcome: Real HTTP and TLS connections with incomplete headers close before entering authentication or the MCP handler. The real guide_inspect MCP schema omits cache-dir and its handler rejects injected overrides before spawning a CLI or creating the directory; cache/offline remain available and the direct CLI override remains public. The focused tests reproduce both prior defects.
